facts.business: Bharat Parenterals Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in manufacturing and exporting formulations to emerging markets across Africa, Latin America, Europe, ASEAN, West Asia/North Africa, and CIS regions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Africa moved from -0.4% in FY25 to +13% in FY26. Europe, ASEAN, Africa and Latin America grew 13-27% in Apr-May FY27.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No key audit matters communicated; other information not covered by opinion

key_risks: Donor funding remains the binding constraint for malaria and TB programs
Exposure to emerging market currency and regulatory risks
Dependence on tender-based pricing in government/institutional markets
facts.related_party_note: Investments in subsidiaries: Varenyam Healthcare (incorporated 2016), Innoxel Lifesciences (incorporated 2021), and one other subsidiary; total investment at cost Rs 19,350.26 lakhs as at March 31, 2026
